item.title: Attorney General Ellison sends over $38,000 in refunds to consumers harmed by defunct dental clinic
item.description:
Publication Date: September 03, 2026

Settlement enables consumers to obtain refunds of fees they paid for dental services that were not provided from Consumer Protection Restitution Account
